ges that it installed as root.
Remove docker-engine by hand: https://github.com/mifunedev/agro/blob/main/docs/installation.md#remove-a-root-level-tool
```
- The saved record is left unchanged.
- `docs/installation.md` has a new "Remove a root-level tool" section with numbered steps for each tool. For `desktop`, it says to keep Tailscale if it was already installed. I checked the file paths and package names in the steps against the install scripts.
- The `agro tool` help text and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated.

**Things you might want to change:**
- **`--host` shows a different message.** `agro tool uninstall <tool> --host` still exits 1, but with the existing "`--host` applies to install only" error instead of the removal guidance, because that check runs first. I left it alone and noted it in the Lessons section of `prd.md`.
- **The removal steps have not been run on a real host.** They follow the install scripts, but nobody has tried them on Ubuntu.
- **Docker data deletion is included.** One optional Docker step deletes all images and volumes, including the AGRO sandbox volumes. The docs warn about this.

I'm not proposing any issues. The PR body, the Stories checklist, and the "Ready for review" step in `/git` are waiting until you allow pushing and GitHub.
